expected_root_cause: defaultUsage writes the Usage header to os.Stderr directly instead of the FlagSet's configured Output writer, so callers cannot capture or redirect the complete usage output.
fix_summary: Write the usage header through CommandLine.Output so the configured FlagSet destination receives it.
curation_notes: PR #502 changes the default usage destination from os.Stderr to the configured FlagSet output; the commit is directly based on the preceding pflag tree.
